description: The line plot illustrates the BLEU score across epochs for three different data sets: regular members, held-out data, and a third category labeled "Held-out data" in the legend (which appears to be a duplicate label). The x-axis, labeled "Epochs," ranges from 0 to 3.0, with major tick marks at 0.5 intervals, and the y-axis, labeled "BLEU score," ranges from 0.00 to 0.35, with major tick marks at 0.05 intervals. The blue line, representing "Regular members," starts at a BLEU score of approximately 0.02 and shows a gradual increase, fluctuating slightly before reaching a final score of about 0.07 at epoch 3.0. The orange line, representing "Held-out data," begins at a BLEU score of 0.02 and exhibits a steep, continuous increase, rising to a score of approximately 0.36 by epoch 3.0. The green line, also labeled "Held-out data" in the legend, starts at a BLEU score of 0.02 and remains relatively flat, fluctuating slightly between 0.03 and 0.04 across all epochs.
